message.reasoning_content:
need to simulate judge, analyze facts, determine crimes. Facts: assault with steel pipe causing heavy injury (level 6 disability) => intentional injury (故意伤害罪) possibly causing serious injury. Also property damage: smashing shop items valued 2609.78 yuan. That could be vandalism or destruction of property (毁坏财物罪) or maybe robbery? No theft, just damage. Also group assault, could be "寻衅滋事罪" as prosecution says. But we need to decide appropriate crimes under Chinese criminal law.

Intentional injury causing heavy injury: According to Criminal Law Article 234 (故意伤害罪) – if results in serious injury (重伤) => imprisonment. Also if causing disability level 6, still serious.

Destruction of property: Article 275 (毁坏财物罪) – if value relatively small, maybe less than 2000 yuan? Here 2609.78 > 2000, qualifies for criminal liability. So "毁坏财物罪".

Also group assault could be "聚众斗殴罪"? But they used steel pipe, not just fight. Could be "聚众斗殴罪" (Article 293) if group of 5 or more? Actually article 293: "聚众斗殴" defined as 3 or more persons. Here 5 persons. So could be "聚众斗殴罪". However they also used weapons, maybe "寻衅滋事罪" (Article 293 also includes causing public order). But typical classification: assault causing injury is intentional injury; property damage is destruction of property; group assault may be "聚众斗殴罪". The prosecution suggested "寻衅滋事罪". Judge may consider both.

We need to output one or multiple crimes separated by semicolon. Provide reasoning then final answer.

Thus final answer: [罪名]故意伤害罪;毁坏财物罪<eoa>
